scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package: npm run lint && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename forcedvr-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist --filename forcedvr-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && npm run test:browser
